execution_code_source: exact target Git blob snapshot, not dirty parent worktree
runtime_duration_semantics: cooperative checks at runtime boundaries, not a kill timer for an in-flight SDK request
query_logs_alias_semantics: exact frozen query_logs row, not the live last hour and not a new collection window
matching_rule: literal argument-dictionary equality plus tool-source binding; omitted log bounds are the one explicit alias; equivalent-looking or partial timestamps are not normalized
unmatched_queries: no_data or deterministic rejection; never live Loki/Prometheus/version fallback

outgoing_fields.tool_scope: only full frozen results including captured_result, sanitized_projection, originals paths/hashes and historical time/source metadata; all exact content is in package.json
outgoing_fields.dynamic_followups: previous approved input + actual validated complete provider output in original order + actual committed function_call_output bound to call_id, saved call and saved evidence record; no missing output synthesis
outgoing_fields.last_round: round 3 tools=[] and tool_choice=none; any returned function_call fails before execution
outgoing_fields.checks: inspect_input source projection, field/value checks and byte limit; actual credential-value check at authorized execution; not universal natural-language secret detection
not_sent: old approval or ledger as new permission

stop_conditions: no new explicit human approval, missing integrity binding, occupied fresh plan ledger or source/environment drift: stop before SDK
first provider/transport/protocol/sensitive-data error: bounded terminal failure, preserve originals, no automatic rerun
max 3 SDK entries, 4 reserved tool executions including probe, 1 run_once; never retry/resume/fallback/replenish
unmatched historical query returns no_data or rejection, never supplement with current collection
third round asks for tools: fail; model ends without tools: retain original answer and mark multi-round objective unproven
empty/incomplete/unknown outcome: preserve evidence, stop and seek separate review; unused old/new slots are not permission to rerun
success_criteria: real first response legal allowed function_call
real second request contains authentic saved call/output pair
real second response continues or concludes from that result
semantic_acceptance: COMPLETED is process status only; conclusion remains pending independent semantic review and separate human acceptance; recovery unknown
consumption_policy: existing exclusive xb reservation before credentials/SDK; failed/timeout attempts are never automatically replayed; old parent-workspace ledger is history only
cost_risks: tariff, account balance and actual currency fee unknown offline
up to three paid entries with growing resent input
bytes are not tokens; output setting is not a currency cap
timeout/HTTP error may still be billed; local entry is not server receipt or billing proof
30 second SDK timeout and 3600 second cooperative runtime setting are not experiment hard wall-clock deadlines
delivery_commit_policy: delivery commit may advance parent main with preparation documents only; experiment code remains this exact target snapshot; never silently substitute newer main
